This page has a wrapped table whose cells hold markup that Quarto and the main LaTeX writer must process, a wrapped table with `tbl-colwidths`, and a wrapped table with a foot.

| Kind      | Cell                        |
|-----------|-----------------------------|
| strike    | ~~gone~~                    |
| underline | [under]{.underline}         |
| code      | `x <- 1`{.r}                |
| cite      | see [@knuth]                |
| xref      | see @tbl-widths             |
| meta      | M{{< meta cellkey >}}M      |
| note      | note[^1]                    |

: A table whose cells hold markup {#tbl-cells .wrap-right width="45%"}

## A table with a foot

::: {#tbl-foot .wrap-right width="40%"}

```{.html-table}
<table>
<thead><tr><th>Item</th><th>Count</th></tr></thead>
<tbody><tr><td>apple</td><td>BODYROW</td></tr></tbody>
<tfoot><tr><td>Total</td><td>FOOTSUM</td></tr></tfoot>
</table>
```
